note: Wind-sport places around the island, each placed on an OpenStreetMap feature: the named beach, bay, slipway, lake or club it is called after, or, for a place named after a town or townland, the mapped beach or shore point nearest it. Where the feature is a line or area the coordinate is one of its own vertices (`sourceNode`). These are references to where people ride, not verified launches.
